observations: Photo 0: A black PlayStation 4 console with 'PS4' logo visible on the front right corner. Two controllers are placed on top: one black, one with colorful paint splatter design. A power cable and adapter are visible.
Photo 1: Same console from a top-down angle, showing the PS4 logo on the top left. The same two controllers are present. The console surface shows scratches and wear.

Photo 2: Console from a front-three-quarter angle, showing the PS4 logo on the top right. The colorful controller is in front, black controller behind. Power cable and adapter are visible. The console surface has visible scuffs and marks.

A clear photo of the model label on the console or a screenshot of the system settings showing the storage capacity.
